concerns.text: T040b-gen (Generate Verified Synthetic Base) is listed as a parallel task [P] but has a hard dependency on T040 (Fetch Real Data) failing. The task description states 'Trigger: Only executed if T040 raises FileNotFoundError'. Parallel execution is impossible here; T040b-gen must be ordered AFTER T040 completes (and fails). Marking it [P] is a semantic violation of the producer-consumer flow.

T040c (Adapt Synthetic Parameters) is marked [P] but depends on T040 succeeding. The task description states 'Trigger: Executed only if T040 succeeds'. This creates a conditional dependency that cannot be parallelized with T040. T040c must be ordered strictly after T040 (success path).

T040b-doc (Verify Synthetic Base Documentation) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T040b-gen. The task states 'DEPENDS ON: T040b-gen'. Parallel execution is impossible. T040b-doc must be ordered after T040b-gen.

T008-code (Write Unit Test Code) and T008-run (Run Unit Test) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but T008-run explicitly depends on T008-code ('DEPENDS ON: T010, T008-code'). Tests cannot run before code is written. The [P] tag is incorrect for T008-run relative to T008-code.

T009 (Unit test for homogeneity) is marked [P] but depends on T010 ('DEPENDS ON: T010'). While T009 might be parallel to T008, it cannot be parallel to T010. The [P] tag implies no dependencies, which is false here.
T034c (Sensitivity Sweep Verification) is marked [P] but depends on T034d ('DEPENDS ON: T034d'). Verification cannot run before the sweep is executed. The [P] tag is invalid.
T034e (Stability Analysis) is marked [P] but depends on T014b and T034d ('DEPENDS ON: T014b, T034d'). It cannot run in parallel with its inputs.
T028 (Generate Report) is marked [P] but depends on T034d, T034e, T021, T018 ('DEPENDS ON: T034d, T034e, T021, T018'). It cannot be parallelized with these upstream tasks.
T031 (Run full integration test) is marked [P] but depends on T014 and T034 completion ('NOTE: ... depends on T014 and T034 completion'). It cannot be parallelized with the tasks it validates.
